runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts once 180 days have passed after the memo is issued. It applies to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of the memorandum, as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after that 180-day date.

The consolidated table of required actions is consistent with this timeline. It lists a 180-day deadline for each agency to achieve full compliance with the memorandum's guidance.

The 180-day trigger is tied to when the solicitation is issued, not when the contract is awarded.

The earlier memo, M-24-18, uses the same 180-day rule for its "other contracts for AI." It also covers contracts awarded from solicitations issued 180 days after its issuance, and options exercised after that date. That is separate from M-25-22.
